Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that the 2004 film The Prince & Me was directed by Catherine Cyran based on a misleading search snippet, without verifying the source or cross-checking (e.g., IMDb/Wikipedia page). This conflated the sequel’s director (Catherine Cyran) with the original 2004 film, which was directed by Martha Coolidge, and also overlooked that Kam Heskin did not play Paige Morgan in the 2004 film.
